source.content: public class Box implements Comparable { public Integer rank; public Integer compareTo(Object other) { Box otherBox = (Box)other; if (rank == otherBox.rank) { return 0; } if (rank > otherBox.rank) { return 1; } return -1; } }

public class DescComparator implements Comparator<Object> { public Integer compare(Object left, Object right) { Integer leftInt = (Integer)left; Integer rightInt = (Integer)right; if (leftInt == rightInt) { return 0; } if (leftInt < rightInt) { return 1; } return -1; } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeComparableComparatorDispatchTest { @isTest static void comparableAndComparatorDispatchThroughListSort() { Box high = new Box(); high.rank = 2; Box low = new Box(); low.rank = 1; List<Box> boxes = new List<Box>{ high, low }; boxes.sort(); System.assertEquals(1, boxes[0].rank); List<Object> nums = new List<Object>{ 2, 1, 3 }; nums.sort(new DescComparator()); System.assertEquals(3, nums[0]); } }
